honest_limits: An upstream window is a PROXY for a promoter, not a mapped transcription start site.
One organism (E. coli K-12). Says nothing about transfer to another host.

A k-mer discriminator measures LOCAL composition; the published audits that separate generated from natural sequence name LONG-RANGE organisation as the failure, which k-mer features cannot see. So a low distinguishability here is necessary, NOT sufficient.
dna_decode/constraints is CDS-shaped and INAPPLICABLE to non-coding sequence; it is not run and no vacuous pass-rate is reported.
